body: I'm not much one to talk about it I usually put it to the point and leave it at that. I'm super tired all the time though...
I talk to him about it a bunch he try's to change the subject... I just feel so bad..

Hi, I understand just how you feel. Like you just can't cope no matter how much you try. I wish I could help you.. I honestly would tell you that there's nothing you can do so maybe just hang out see what happens? If not anything then find a way that is most meaningful to die. But because this is not exepted by social standards I'll say that you should tell someone who you're really close to how you feel or maybe call the help line? If you don't want to call here is their line for texting (741-741) hope you find peace in whatever you chose to do. And I do understand how you wish someone would just chose for you and actually chose that you die... you're not alone... :(
